selectionRule: The three supplied lessons plus relevant discovered lessons with at least 1,000,000 views and verified English original/dub audio.

videos.title: Star–Delta Starter: Power Wiring and Standard Timer Control
videos.sourceTitle: Star Delta Starter इससे आसान कुछ भी नही अगर सीखना चाहते है तो एक बार जरूर देखिये।

transcript.reviewQualification: Complete Hindi ASR read with translation; English automatic-dub availability separately verified. This is not an English-dub transcript review.

videos.teaches: Physical power wiring, six motor terminals, three contactors, overload trip contacts, start/stop holding and conventional timed cross-interlocking.
videos.flowRationale: After the existing nameplate and control-circuit foundations; the complete power/control build precedes the focused control-only demonstration.
videos.limits: Hindi ASR was reviewed with translation. The independent English auto-dub is available. Coil ratings, colours, overload location/settings and terminal numbering are equipment-specific. Separate live control supplies are not isolated by switching off only the power breaker. Control schematics are loosely called single-line/key diagrams.

videos.title: Star–Delta Starter: Holding Circuit, Timer and Interlocks
videos.sourceTitle: Star Delta Starter Control Wiring Explained Practically @TheElectricalGuy

transcript.reviewQualification: Complete available English caption text read; audio metadata independently distinguishes English original from an English automatic dub.

videos.teaches: Builds the DOL holding circuit first, adds the star/delta timer, then reciprocal NC electrical interlocks and demonstrates the sequence.
videos.flowRationale: Follows the full power/control project, reinforcing control logic on real contactors and a dedicated timer.
videos.limits: The demonstrated 500 ms transition and star duration are examples, not universal settings. Manual contactor operation is a demonstration rather than a maintenance instruction; a real starter requires suitable interlocking and manufacturer coordination.

videos.title: Star–Delta Control Variant: Timer NC and Auxiliary Contacts
videos.sourceTitle: Unic Star Delta Starter ! Use Only Timer NC With Key Diagram (SLD)  @Tech_Gaurav

transcript.reviewQualification: Complete available English caption text read; audio metadata independently distinguishes English original from an English automatic dub.

videos.teaches: A different auxiliary-contact circuit uses the timer NC, main holding path and star/delta auxiliary contacts, then adds status indications.
videos.flowRationale: Optional comparison after conventional star/delta circuits and practical wiring; it is not the first or only starter model.
videos.limits: The claim that timer failure cannot damage the motor is not a general guarantee. Removing a neutral/control return does not establish safe isolation. A validated break-before-make arrangement, appropriate mechanical/electrical interlocking and protection still depend on the actual design. Captions simplify NO/NC operation and control-drawing terminology.

videos.title: Variable-Frequency Drives: Purpose, Operation and Pump Applications
videos.sourceTitle: What is a VFD? (Variable Frequency Drive)

transcript.reviewQualification: Complete available English caption text read; audio metadata independently distinguishes English original from an English automatic dub.

videos.teaches: A short rectifier/DC-link/inverter overview connects variable frequency to motor speed and pump-flow control, with manual and PLC examples.
videos.flowRationale: Introduces purpose and applications before the existing longer internal-power-stage lesson.
videos.limits: The water/filter analogy simplifies DC-link energy storage and ripple smoothing; the clip does not teach drive selection, detailed programming, isolation or regenerative hardware.

videos.title: Choosing a Soft Starter or Variable-Frequency Drive
videos.sourceTitle: What is the Difference between VFD and Soft Starter?

transcript.reviewQualification: Complete available English caption text read; audio metadata independently distinguishes English original from an English automatic dub.

videos.teaches: Compares soft starting with continuous speed control using pump and fan examples, then discusses size, cost and application requirements.
videos.flowRationale: Follows the short VFD introduction and existing soft-starter foundation; detailed VFD construction then follows.
videos.limits: The SCR account omits natural commutation: removing gate drive does not instantly turn off a latched SCR. Soft starters do not regulate steady-state motor speed. The general replacement/price/size statements require actual load and manufacturer checks, and are not universal interchangeability rules.

reviewScope: Complete available caption text read for all five; English audio availability verified using YouTube adaptive audio-track metadata. No continuous independent listening to every English dub or full visual electrical-design approval is claimed.
screening: Popular feeds were checked for The Electrical Guy, Tech Gaurav and the creator-linked Electrical Technician channel. Their screened VFD lessons were below 1,000,000 views; two relevant original-English RealPars lessons meet the threshold. Popular unrelated lessons and repetitive timer examples were not added just for view counts.
